item.description:
🏓 [ FREE & WEEKLY ] ALL IS SETUP FOR FREE PICKLEBALL GAME | All Skills Welcome!
We're excited to announce that everything is set up for COMPLETELY FREE PICKLEBALL GAME: pickleball net, court, paddles, and balls—so you can just show up and play. All we need is you to complete our COMPLETELY FREE PICKLEBALL GAME, one in a set of always COMPLETELY FREE GAMES!
*Welcome to the Guest List!* ​Get on the Line-Up for today’s games. ​We are thrilled to have you on the court! To keep our community running smoothly and fairly, please take 10 seconds to JOIN the daily list.
​*Why JOIN the Guest List?* ​**Priority Play (The Digital Line)**: We have a lot of players but limited nets. By signing up, you **secure your spot in the rotation. It’s a digital line**—if you’re on the list, *your spot is saved so you don't have to stand around waiting.*
​**Safety & Gear**: This sign-up acts as our liability waiver and helps us track our equipment. It ensures everyone has *access to quality rackets and nets and that we can keep providing them for free.*
​**Better Matches**: Knowing who is coming helps us organize *games by skill level, so you get the most out of your time at the park*.
We’ll be glad to see you on the pickleball court soon!
Looking for a fun, social, and active way to spend your weekend morning? **JOIN our FREE weekly Co-Ed Pickleball meetup in Philly!** Whether you're a beginner or an experienced player, this is your chance to learn, play, and connect with a great community. All skill levels are welcome—just bring your energy, and we’ll bring the fun!

item.title: 🥳 2027 Mummers Parade Philadelphia
item.description:
*!!!Advices:
1.Wear something warm, as you'll be outside for a few hours!
2.Bring a chair, or let me know if you'd like me to take one for you.
3.Warm drinks are a good idea, though you can grab some at the nearby Starbucks.
4.Restrooms 🚻 are available, but you'll need to walk to reach them 🙂.
About the 2027 Mummers Parade*
Step into one of **America’s most iconic New Year’s tradition**s and **kick off 2027 the Philly way** 🎭✨ [GREEN][/GREEN] For more than *125 years*, the legendary *Philadelphia Mummers Parade* has *turned Broad Street into a full-day explosion of color, music, humor, and unmistakable Philadelphia spirit*. On *Thursday, January 1, 2027, more than 10,000 performers — adults and children — will twirl, sashay, pirouette, and strut through the heart of the city in lavish, hand-crafted costumes that redefine creativity and joy*.
*Never been?* Imagine the energy of** New Orleans Mardi Gras, Broadway-level costumes, fearless satire, and raw Philly attitude** — all blended into one unforgettable **New Year’s Day celebration**.
🎺 *What makes the Mummers Parade legendary:* • Fancies stun the crowd with glittering, royal-level costumes • Comic & Wench Brigades deliver sharp, hilarious satire of current events and public figures • Fancy Brigades present theatrical, tightly choreographed extravaganzas • String Bands march joyfully while filling Broad Street with banjos, saxophones, drums, and infectious rhythms.
⭐ *What people say across the internet:* “Absolutely one of the most unique parades in the world.” “The best free New Year’s Day event you can attend.” “Pure Philly creativity — loud, colorful, and unforgettable.” “Once you see it, you’ll come back every year.”
🎉 *You’re Invited* Whether you’re a *lifelong Philadelphian or visiting for the first time*, the 2027 Mummers Parade is more than a parade — it’s a living tradition, a citywide party, and a celebration of art, humor, and community. Dress warm, bring your friends, and prepare for a full day of smiles, music, and jaw-dropping performances.
*Start 2027 surrounded by thousands of happy faces and the heartbeat of the city*. This is *Philadelphia at its boldest, brightest, and most joyful*.

item.title: 🎅🎄 Manayunk Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony | Canal View Park
item.description:
J O I N our WhatsApp Community in advance to receive live event assistance and real-time location sharing:
https://chat.whatsapp.com/F3Zp5U1wIbB9V146DQmGLw
* our hosts may be busy running the event, so they might not be available to confirm your participation individually at the event time.
🎅🎄 Join **CenterCity.Events** for the **Manayunk Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony** — *Philadelphia's largest tree lighting celebration* — at **Canal View Park, 4418 Main Street, Philadelphia, PA 19127**! We **meet at 5:15 PM**, 15 minutes before the ceremony, so we get a *great spot together* before the **live performances** begin at 5:30 PM.
Expect a magical evening: performances by the **Ghostlight Players**, **John Viscardi & Lady Alma** and the **City Belles**, *glow giveaways*, ornament decorating, and a surprise visit from **Santa Claus** himself — with magical *North Pole snow* from giant snow machines! Santa leads the crowd in an **Eagles cheer**, and at **7:00 PM sharp** the giant tree lights up Main Street. The lighting also kicks off **Manayunk Gets Lit**, the famous decorating competition where *50+ local businesses* light up their storefronts with **80,000+ lights**.
This event is *free*, outdoors and family-friendly — dress warm! We stay together as a group until 7:30 PM; after the lighting, feel free to stroll Main Street with new friends and enjoy the glowing storefronts, hot cocoa and holiday shopping.
What people said about the previous Manayunk tree lightings: ⭐ "Main Street looked like a Hallmark movie the moment the tree lit up." ⭐ "Santa leading the Eagles cheer before the lighting — only in Philly!" ⭐ "The snow machines and glow giveaways made it pure magic for the kids." ⭐ "The best neighborhood tree lighting in the city — every storefront shines for the competition." #Manayunk #ChristmasTreeLighting #ManayunkGetsLit #CenterCityEvents #PhillyEvents

item.title: 🦃 Oldest in The USA Thanksgiving Day Parade | Philadelphia
item.description:
Join CenterCity.Events for the **6abc Dunkin' Thanksgiving Day Parade** — the *oldest* Thanksgiving parade in the country, now in its *107th year*! We meet at **20th Street & John F. Kennedy Boulevard, Philadelphia, PA 19103** at *10:00 AM sharp*, then watch the parade roll down Benjamin Franklin Parkway to the **Philadelphia Museum of Art** steps, wrapping up around noon.
Expect *giant balloons*, colorful floats, marching bands, dancers, and a visit from **Santa** himself to kick off the holiday season. Great viewing spots line the Parkway — Logan Circle, LOVE Park, and Eakins Oval are all close to our meeting point. It is *free*, outdoors, and runs rain or shine, so dress warm and arrive early for a good curb spot!
Reviews from past years call it "a beloved Philly tradition the whole family loves," "the best way to start Thanksgiving morning," and praise the "amazing balloons, music and energy all along the Parkway." Come start Thanksgiving with friends!

item.title: 🎄🎅 Christmas Village Walk
item.description:
🎄 Christmas Village Walk with CenterCity.Events 🎄
This is not our first Christmas Village Walk — **we at CenterCity.Events have already made this walk many times**, year after year, and it has become one of our favorite holiday traditions! Join us on **Saturday, December 5 at 6:00 PM** at LOVE Park and feel the real *Christmas magic* of Philadelphia: the authentic German-style holiday market that transforms LOVE Park and City Hall into a European Christmas wonderland, with **120+ wooden stalls**, the 30-foot German Christmas pyramid glowing above the park, the double-decker carousel in the City Hall courtyard and the Ferris wheel lighting up the skyline.
Our plan is simple and perfect: we *walk together through Christmas Village*, listen to the **live holiday music**, browse the famous Käthe Wohlfahrt tent and the local makers' booths, and **shop for ornaments, gifts and crafts** to take home. Come hungry — follow the smell of raclette cheese, bratwurst from the swivel grills, schnitzel, strudel and Belgian fries. We will take group photos by the **LOVE statue** and the big Christmas tree, and soak up every sparkle of the *Christmas magic* around us.
And after the walk? We finish the way every great winter walk should end: with **coffee at our exclusive booked spot near the campfire** — warm drinks, a real fire, and our CenterCity.Events family sharing stories while the Village lights glow around us. It is the coziest ending in the city, and it is *only for our group*.
⭐ What people say online: Visitor roundups call the raclette "worth the wait" and the hot chocolate a close second favorite, and the City Hall courtyard with its carousel is rated the favorite corner of the market (Ultimate Christmas Markets). Tripadvisor reviewers call it "a nice place to browse," praise the delicious hot chocolate on a cold December afternoon, and say it must be beautiful in the evening under the holiday lights. Visit Philly describes it as an endearing old-world market with a festive glow right in the heart of the city.
Practical notes: Admission to Christmas Village is **FREE** — food, drinks, gifts and rides are pay-as-you-go. We meet at **6:00 PM sharp** (the walk runs 6:00-9:30 PM) under the holiday lights to enjoy the market before the biggest weekend crowds. Dress warmly, wear comfortable walking shoes, and bring your holiday spirit — this is one of the most joyful walks of the year with our CenterCity.Events family!

item.title: 🧊 Founders Philly Freeze-Out 2027
item.description:
